versions.changelog:
doubao-ai-toolkit v1.0.1

- Introduced strict version pinning for core dependencies and locked transitive dependencies with package-lock.json.
- Added supply chain controls: disables lifecycle scripts via .npmrc, enforces install reproducibility, and instructs users to avoid global/temporary installs.
- Included explicit privacy, key management, and data transmission checks for all file uploads, URLs, and callbacks.
- Provided local npm script-based CLI usage and modernized command templates.
- Removed legacy documentation (skill-card.md); added automated security test.

Initial release of doubao-ai-toolkit.

- Provides CLI access to ByteDance Doubao AI models: image generation, video generation, TTS, ASR, chat, search, and embedding.
- Includes core commands: `coze-coding-ai` (all-in-one), `seedream` (image), and `seedance` (video).
- Detailed install and authentication instructions using environment variables or CLI options.
- Offers comprehensive command templates and usage examples for all supported features.
- Documents available models, speaker IDs, parameter options, and advanced usage notes.
